app.q: Do my customers need to download an app?
app.a: No. Customers scan the QR code with their phone camera and the survey opens in the browser.

arabic.a: Yes. Arabic comes first, and customers can switch to English with one tap.

branches.q: Can I use it for more than one location?
branches.a: Yes. Add your locations and each one gets its own QR code and its own results, which you can compare.

edit.q: Can I change the survey questions?
edit.a: Yes. Start from a template, then add, remove or reorder questions and publish changes whenever you like.

privacy.a: Yes. Each business's data is kept separate, and only your team can see responses. The survey doesn't ask customers for personal details.

setup.a: Minutes. Create your account, add your location, publish the ready-made survey and print the QR code.

finalCta.title: Start listening to your customers today
finalCta.body: Create your account and publish your first survey in minutes.
